_meta.rule: Kilian 2026-11-17 'yes apply it to tech and software as suggested': names in scope whose main leg is P/E carry a FCF yield leg (levered FCF, peer median FCF / market cap on the same plain-FCF basis, no SBC deduction) at 40% of the P/E weight, P/E keeps 60%. Only where the forward FCF margin is >= 2% in every projected year; otherwise no FCF leg. Applied at each name's next update round, never by editing a live round. A move of the research target (12m) over 5% from adding the leg goes to Kilian as a card.
